reasons.persona_fit: Speaks directly to the owner-operator dilemma with Bareni's calm, practical tone and no CTA; slightly misplaces dual running in the diagnostic rather than pilot phase.
reasons.clarity: Main point and trade-offs are immediately clear, logically sequenced, and explained in plain English without unnecessary jargon.
reasons.actionability: Provides two concrete self-diagnostic questions regarding time investment and decision points to evaluate if dual running is viable.
reasons.factual_grounding: Strictly adheres to boundaries, explicitly maintains mandatory human approval for high-risk decisions, and invents no customers or results.
